content.ascii:
[R] Immutable content and revision lifecycle
|
|-- DiagramRevision: id / diagramId / parentId? / nodeRefs
|   `-- Diagram: diagramId / revisionId; id / revision
|       |-- DiagramContent: ASCII + hash; tree or freeform structure
|       `-- sourceContext: contentHash, binding, mappings, evidence
|-- DiagramNode binds a placement to {diagramId, revisionId}
|   `-- presentation holds geometry, fold/diff view, highlights
|
|-- create / revise / derive -> validated, frozen revision
|   `-- preserve proven logical nodeRefs across revisions
|-- retain / import -> runtime revision store
|   `-- generation or supplied ASCII -> submit edit -> retain
`-- controller publishes revision -> CanvasHistory checkpoint
    `-- persistence flushes referenced revision records

Content operations take explicit inputs; retention is separate.
Presentation changes leave the bound revision unchanged.
